    • Method Detail

      • register

        public User register​(java.lang.String username,
                     java.lang.String password)
              throws java.sql.SQLException
        Registers a local account after hashing the password with SHA-256.
        Parameters:
        username - nonblank username; surrounding whitespace is removed
        password - nonempty raw password; whitespace is preserved
        Returns:
        newly persisted user; does not log the user in
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if username is blank, password is null or empty, or the username is taken
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails

      • login

        public boolean login​(java.lang.String username,
                     java.lang.String password)
              throws java.sql.SQLException
        Authenticates credentials and replaces the current session user. Invalid or unmatched credentials clear the session; database errors propagate.
        Parameters:
        username - account username, trimmed for lookup
        password - raw password to hash and compare
        Returns:
        true if authenticated; false for invalid or unmatched credentials
        Throws:
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails

      • changePassword

        public void changePassword​(java.lang.String currentPassword,
                           java.lang.String newPassword,
                           java.lang.String confirmation)
                    throws java.sql.SQLException
        Changes only the signed-in account's password, preserving its session. Uses the existing hash format for compatibility with local accounts.
        Parameters:
        currentPassword - current raw password to verify
        newPassword - nonempty replacement raw password, different from the current one
        confirmation - exact repetition of the replacement password
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalStateException - if no user is signed in
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if a password is missing, confirmation differs, the replacement is unchanged, or the current password is incorrect
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails
